label: A frozen 66-row fixture-derived holdout already exists (20 harder-corpus rows, 40 regression-case rows, 6 delegation rows) with per-row provenance and every gold copied from its source fixture's expected field.

Held-out discipline is mechanical: family-normalized collision drop against labeled-prompts.jsonl, SHA-256-pinned corpus/holdout/ambiguity fixtures, and a ratchet that holds every metric to a committed baseline.
Negatives are first-class gold-none rows: 18 in the labeled corpus, 6 in the holdout, tracked as gold_none_false_fire=5 and unknown_count=13 in the baseline.

Working scale: corpus 195 rows at 0.7846 top-1, holdout 66 at 0.7424, ambiguity 24 at 0.75 (tau 0.03), buckets 31/32/9, floors 0.75 full-corpus and 0.725 holdout; prompt sources are synthetic and paraphrased, with real hook telemetry deferred.

The 17-positive-plus-5-negative SA-001 probe battery is a published smoke battery, not a held-out set: probes are parsed from a committed markdown table, P2-P10 are copied from the labeled corpus, and nothing pins the probe set.

Residual overlap risk: the harder-intent fixture supplies both 20 holdout rows and the lane-weight sweep corpus, so holdout rows are disjoint from explicit-lane tuning but not from lane-weight experimentation; scope holdout against every tuning surface.
